verdict.rationale: EBANX's own docs cover a payment flow end to end: hosted checkout and direct API options, one unified API, a sandbox with ready-to-use test card objects and expected responses, an interactive API Reference that sends requests, error-code docs, and notification webhooks. An integration prompt that generates runnable code snippets also suggests a reasonably self-serve path. However, nothing shows per-language copy-paste examples or SDKs, nothing corroborates the under-a-day time-to-integrate, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: documented copy-paste code samples across multiple languages/SDKs, hands-on or independent evidence of a sub-day integration, and a published OpenAPI spec.
